gen-flavors-gf-port-lligat-slab: Flavors has a towering x-height and bent-wire letters, all whimsy. Port Lligat Slab is the quieter voice, a serif with porthole-wide counters and curves left open to breathe, which gives the pair its loudest-meets-bookish charm.
gen-flavors-gf-quando: Chunky, cheeky, impossible to ignore. Flavors shouts with diagonals as heavy as its stems and no thick-thin flicker, while Quando, a classic serif, spaces its tall letters out and lets the words settle.
gen-fredoka-crimson-pro: Fredoka draws its letters like a single brush line at constant width, friendly from the first glance. And Crimson Pro, a serif with close-set letters and a gentle thick-thin cadence, gives that softness a refined, bookish backbone.
gen-fredoka-fs-bespoke-slab: Fredoka writes in one untapered line, moderate in height and open in the e. Bespoke Slab, a serif, stands taller in every lowercase letter, so a long passage would feel grounded and steady, a little more formal than the heading.
gen-fredoka-gf-ancizar-serif: Fredoka keeps its stroke constant from start to finish, round and welcoming, with an e that opens clearly. Ancizar Serif, a text serif, adds modest engraved-brass contrast and a gaping c, so extended reading stays bookish and editorial.
gen-fredoka-gf-andada-pro: Andada Pro is the traditional, bookish half, a serif whose strokes swing moderately from heavy to light. Fredoka earns its keep big and short, its fixed nib width and open e giving headings an approachable grin.
gen-fredoka-gf-aref-ruqaa: Dignified and traditional, Aref Ruqaa gives a classic serif's mild shading across its round and straight strokes. And Fredoka, bent like a single length of wire, brings the friendly side, so the two feel warm and formal at once.
gen-fredoka-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Aref Ruqaa Ink, a text serif, lightly modulates its strokes and keeps every aperture open. And Fredoka holds one constant pen width above it, so a long passage reads literary and gentle, never fussy.
gen-fredoka-gf-average: Average reads with an authoritative, literary voice, its e gaping wide and its curves thickening like a reed pen. And Fredoka brings a friendlier hand, its up and side strokes identical, against the text serif's subtle etched-glass shading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed is clean and contemporary, true monoline with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and wide curve entrances. Metamorphous commands the top with generous sidebearings and a soft fat-slim stroke, while the sans keeps the text crisp.
